Då kan du vara vår nästa Business Controller. Hos oss blir du en del av ett dynamiskt svenskt-danskt företag och en av Skandinaviens största hamnoperatörer, där du får en drivande roll i att utveckla analys, rapportering och beslutsstöd. Du förväntas aktivt identifiera utvecklingsmöjligheter och driva initiativ inom AI och automatisering från idé till genomförande. Du utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter, dashboards och datamodeller i Power BI samt arbetar för hög och tillförlitlig datakvalitet. Rollen omfattar även ekonomisk uppföljning och ansvar för att bidra till ett korrekt och rättvisande resultat. Du arbetar självständigt inom ditt område och samarbetar nära chefer och verksamhetsansvariga i både Sverige och Danmark. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva initiativ inom AI och automatisering från idé till implementerad lösning. Effektivisera ekonomiprocesser, rapportering och återkommande arbetsmoment genom standardisering, automatiserade arbetsflöden och nya digitala arbetssätt. Utveckla hur AI används inom ekonomistyrning, analys och rapportering för att skapa ökad kvalitet, snabbare processer och tydlig verksamhetsnytta. Bygga, utveckla och förvalta rapporter, dashboards och datamodeller i Power BI. Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra modeller, processer, systemstöd och data för ekonomistyrning, analys och rapportering. Ansvara för ekonomisk uppföljning, rapportering och analys på månads-, kvartals- och årsbasis samt omsätta resultatet i tydliga insikter och rekommendationer. Utveckla och följa upp relevanta KPI:er som synliggör verksamhetens resultat, utveckling och måluppfyllelse. Ta fram kvalificerade besluts- och presentationsunderlag samt genomföra scenario-, känslighets- och ad hoc-analyser som stöd för styrelse, ledning och verksamhet. Säkerställa ett korrekt och rättvisande resultat genom löpande controlling, avstämningar, rimlighetskontroller och avvikelseanalyser samt aktivt bidra i månadsbokslutet. Samordna insamling, strukturering och kvalitetssäkring av underlag till budget och prognos. Vara ett proaktivt, affärsmässigt och finansiellt stöd som stöttar och utmanar verksamheten samt driver tvärfunktionella utvecklingsinitiativ. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är analytisk, affärsorienterad och lösningsorienterad. Du har ett starkt utvecklingsdriv och ser hur AI, automatisering och datadrivna arbetssätt kan användas för att modernisera och effektivisera ekonomistyrningen. Du identifierar möjligheter, omsätter idéer i konkreta förbättringar och driver utvecklingen framåt. Du arbetar självständigt, skapar struktur i komplexa frågor och bygger förtroendefulla relationer. Du kommunicerar tydligt och vågar utmana etablerade arbetssätt för att skapa verklig verksamhetsnytta. Kvalifikationer Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom ekonomi eller motsvarande. Erfarenhet som Business Controller, konsult eller i en liknande verksamhetsnära och analytisk roll. God kunskap inom ekonomistyrning, budgetering, prognoser, finansiell uppföljning och rapportering. Förmåga att självständigt utveckla datadrivna rapporter, dashboards och beslutsstöd i Power BI eller motsvarande BI-verktyg. Erfarenhet av att automatisera processer och effektivisera arbetsflöden. God system- och dataförståelse, inklusive datakvalitet, databehandling och strukturering av data för analys och uppföljning. Förmåga att kombinera ekonomisk analys, teknisk förståelse och affärsperspektiv. Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift. Förståelse för danska. Meriterande: Erfarenhet av att tillämpa AI i ekonomiprocesser, analys eller rapportering. God förståelse för redovisning. Erfarenhet av Power BI, Planning Analytics eller liknande BI- och planeringsverktyg samt Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations eller motsvarande affärssystem. Erfarenhet av datamodellering och utveckling av BI-lösningar i Power BI eller liknande verktyg. Vi erbjuder På CMP får du en central roll i en internationell och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att driva utveckling inom AI och automatisering samt påverka hur vi arbetar med dataanalys, datakvalitet och beslutsstöd. Du får samtidigt utveckla rapportering och dashboards i Power BI och omsätta idéer i konkreta förbättringar för verksamheten. Övrig information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placeringsort Malmö. Provanställning tillämpas under 6 månader. Ansökan, deadline och anställning: Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Din ansökan vill vi ha senast den 13:e december. Vi tar ej emot ansökningar via e-post. Vår kärnverksamhet inkluderar hantering av bilar, containrar, Ro-Ro, järnväg, logistik, våt- och torrbulk samt kryssnings- och färjetrafik. Vi är med vår strategiska placering katalysatorn för Öresundsregionens tillväxt och via innovation, digitalisering och hållbara lösningar arbetar vi i partnerskap för att göra den blå industrin grönare. review_candidates.title: Business Analyst (Product Owner & Analytics)
review_candidates.description: Are you looking for the opportunity to work as a Business Analyst at a fast-growing global company that is digitally transforming manufacturing industries, in an environment where you will have an immediate impact? We’d love to hear from you! SCW.AI by Supply Chain Wizard is a fast-growing technology startup that achieved great product market fit with its Digital Factory platform, has stellar reference customers in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry; and we are looking to expand our product team after closing on a strong Series A fundraising with prestigious investors. At SCW.AI we are building the next-generation digital factory platform for self-driving supply chains. SCW.AI brings Speed, Simplicity, and Scalability to Digital Factory Transformation. The Role   We are looking for a technically minded, highly analytical Business Analyst to act as the Product Owner of one of our Scrum teams, while also solving hands-on analytical problems across our Digital Factory platform and customer projects. Roughly 60% of the role is Product Ownership: requirements analysis, backlog management, prioritization, and coordination with Scrum teams. The remaining 40% is hands-on analysis: SQL-based report development, data investigations, business logic, and algorithm design for platform functions. We are looking for a driven individual who can quickly understand complex business rules and technical systems, communicate fluently with engineering teams, and take on growing responsibility as the product and team scale. We also encourage the effective use of AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. As a member of the SCW.AI product team, you will: Product Ownership Own the backlog of one Scrum team: refine it, prioritize it, and keep it healthy. Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria and edge cases, eliminating ambiguity in product behavior. Lead sprint planning, refinement, and review sessions with the team. Translate customer and stakeholder requests into precise requirements. Track decisions and action items so that nothing falls through the cracks. Analytics Write SQL to build customer reports, and use SQL and Python to answer data questions. Investigate issues quantitatively and find root causes in production data. Design and test algorithms for scheduling, optimization, and similar platform functions. Support customer projects with analysis, data checks, and configuration logic. Pick up ad-hoc tasks across the product team, including the routine ones. Desired Skills and Experience Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or another quantitative field. Strong hands-on SQL skills, including JOINs, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and date/time calculations: you query relational databases on your own. Ability to quickly understand complex technical architectures, data structures and business rules. Strong mathematical, analytical, and logical problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear, actionable steps. Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Willingness to work across both product management and hands-on analytical tasks. Good written and spoken English. Typically 3-5 years in a business analyst, data analyst, product or similar analytical role. (Nice to have's)  Experience with Scrum or Agile methodologies, e.g. as a PO or BA in a Scrum team. You will learn it here either way. Pharmaceutical production, life sciences or manufacturing domain knowledge (GMP, MES, OEE). Python experience (pandas, notebooks) for analysis. Background in scheduling algorithms, operations research or optimization. Experience with BI tools such as Power BI. Familiarity with APIs, relational data models, and software integrations. About Us SCW.AI by Supply Chain Wizard, a two-time Inc. 5000 honoree and a Gartner Cool Vendor in Supply Chain Execution Technologies, is an innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) firm and a global leader specializing in digital factory and digital supply chain solutions. SCW partners with manufacturers in designing, developing and implementing scalable digital solutions using state-of-the-art technologies such as IoT, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning through its cloud platform to enable end-to-end digital supply chain transformations in life sciences, pharmaceutical and consumer goods industries. SCW.AI is dedicated to adding sustainable value through data-driven decision-making from shopfloors to executive boardrooms.  In November 2022, SCW.AI raised a $10M Series A venture funding round led by Atlanta-based venture capital firm, Panoramic Ventures. Among other investors participating in the round are Sabanci Ventures (Corporate Venture Capital arm of Sabanci Holding) and Birthing of Giants (14 of the CEO members of the preeminent Leadership Fellowship Program). The diversity of investors who took part in this round including venture capital, private equity, strategic, corporate and angel investors demonstrates a strong support for SCW.AI's vision in helping manufacturers achieve fully digital, highly automated and self-driving factories, which will enable the long-term objective of developing self-learning and self-driving supply chains. In 2022, SCW.AI by Supply Chain Wizard has been Certified™ Great Place to Work® and named on the list of “Top 10 Best Workplaces in Information Technology - Turkey 2022”. This is the Great Place to Work to grow your career. Learn more about us at: https://scw.ai/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/scw-ai-by-supply-chain-wizard/

NTT DATA es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones tecnológicas, y outsourcing. La compañía, desarrolla su actividad en los sectores de telecomunicaciones, entidades financieras, industria, utilities, energía, administración pública y sanidad. Somos la sexta compañía de servicios IT del mundo, lo que nos permite dar soluciones y servicios en diversas áreas, aumentando las capacidades, recursos tecnológicos, geográficos y financieros de nuestros clientes, además de ayudarles dando las respuestas más innovadoras. Somos una de las pocas compañías en España, con los estándares más altos de excelencia en las condiciones que ofrecemos a nuestros empleados, por eso estamos certificados como Top Employer desde 2016 hasta la actualidad. Apostamos por nuestros empleados y creemos por encima de todo en las personas y en su desarrollo integral, por lo que fomentamos un contexto de libertad responsable que se traduce en un alto rendimiento profesional. Buscamos personas en Galicia con experiencia en HelpDesk para integrarse en nuestro equipo de soporte al usuario (Digital Workplace). ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Experiencia en asistencia técnica y gestión de incidencia de puesto de trabajo. Conocimientos en tratamiento y resolución, así como escalado a niveles de servicio que requieran una mayor especialización. Experiencia en gestión y resolución de incidencias vía telefónica, de aquellas solicitudes respecto a los equipos de trabajo de los usuarios. A excepción de casos que requieran por complejidad elevar a servicios especializados. Experiencia en gestión de plataformas ofimáticas de más de 100 puestos y gestión de permisos. Trabajo mediante metodología ITIL o similar. Se valorará estar en posesión de certificación ITIL y/o conocimientos sobre ISO20000. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? Formación desde el primer día dirigida a la especialización técnica y de transformación digital. Salario en función de la experiencia del candidato. Disponibilidad de diferentes jornadas de trabajo en función a las necesidades del proyecto. Integrarte en una compañía multinacional líder (Una de las 10 compañías más grandes del sector a nivel mundial), joven y dinámica. Formar parte de un ambiente creativo y colaborador donde puedes disfrutar de la experiencia del trabajo en equipo para lograr el máximo valor para nuestros clientes. Trabajar en una empresa en constante evolución y crecimiento, realizando un trabajo enriquecedor con grandes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional. En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad. #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

review_candidates.title: Technical Office Architect
review_candidates.description: About Trio Group Trio Group is a premier organization bridging the gap between innovative architectural vision and precise execution. Under the Trio Group umbrella, we seamlessly integrate three specialized companies to provide comprehensive, high-end solutions: Trio Construction: Dedicated to executing complex, large-scale projects with deep technical expertise, rigorous quality control, and advanced structural engineering. Yours Interior: Focused on delivering bespoke, premium interior designs that perfectly balance stunning aesthetics with smart, functional living. Jozour: Specializing in custom furniture and exquisite woodwork, ensuring the highest standards of craftsmanship and material quality. By operating as a fully integrated entity, Trio Group provides a single point of truth for our clients, guaranteeing flawless execution from blueprint to the final finishing details. Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Office Architect to serve as the critical link between our design concepts and on-site construction. In this role, you will be responsible for translating architectural and interior designs into comprehensive, executable shop drawings, managing project documentation, and ensuring that all finishing and structural elements align with TRIO’s rigorous quality standards. Key Responsibilities Shop Drawings & Detailing: Produce accurate, clash-free architectural and interior shop drawings, including detailed plans, elevations, and intricate finishing details for high-end turnkey projects. Documentation & BOQ: Prepare, review, and update Bill of Quantities (BOQ), material specifications, and technical submittals to ensure alignment with project budgets and design intent. Cross-Discipline Coordination: Actively coordinate with MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and structural teams to resolve design clashes before site execution. Site Support: Liaise directly with site engineers, project managers, and subcontractors to clarify design details, respond to RFIs (Requests for Information), and adjust drawings based on actual site conditions. As-Built Drawings: Track site modifications throughout the project lifecycle and deliver final, accurate as-built drawings upon project handover. Vendor & Material Management: Assist in evaluating supplier and subcontractor technical proposals to ensure proposed materials meet the specified quality and design criteria. Qualifications & Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or a closely related field. Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in AutoCAD, Revit, and Microsoft Office (specifically Excel for BOQs). Familiarity with SketchUp, 3ds Max, or Navisworks is a strong advantage. Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of local building codes, finishing materials, custom joinery, and modern construction methodologies. Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple project timelines simultaneously. Strong communication skills for effective cross-team collaboration.

This role involves implementing sourcing strategies, conducting tenders and negotiations, and executing contracts. Key responsibilities include identifying OpCo requirements, executing procurements, and managing the evaluation process. review_candidates.title: Sr PR & Communications Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Senior PR & Communications Specialist leads the execution of high-impact public relations and media engagement initiatives to protect and elevate the organization's public profile. Operating within the Content & Communications division, this role bridges complex corporate milestones with external audiences, ensuring consistent narrative alignment across traditional and digital channels. By driving strategic media outreach and managing reputation frameworks, the incumbent directly supports the company’s broader brand visibility and stakeholder trust objectives. Responsibilities/Duties Profil de candidat recherché : Strategic Media Relations & Outreach Architect comprehensive media outreach campaigns that effectively promote corporate milestones, service innovations, and strategic achievements across targeted channels. Lead high-level interactions with journalists, editors, and media agencies to secure favorable earned coverage and strengthen institutional partnerships. Coordinate structured press briefings, media tours, and exclusive interviews, ensuring optimal message resonance and brand positioning. Content Development & Narrative Governance Author authoritative press releases, executive speeches, thought-leadership articles, and strategic briefing materials to support external communication goals. Review all public-facing communication collateral to guarantee absolute adherence to corporate tone-of-voice and brand guidelines. Monitor public sentiment, emerging industry trends, and competitor media coverage to proactively identify storytelling opportunities and mitigate narrative risks. Cross-Functional Coordination & Crisis Support Collaborate closely with internal departments—including Marketing, Operations, Legal, and HR—to synchronize messaging and maintain unified communications during critical projects. Support the PR & Communications Manager in executing rapid-response crisis communication protocols, drafting timely statements, and coordinating stakeholder notifications. Facilitate cross-functional training and preparation for company spokespersons participating in high-visibility public appearances or media interviews. Analytics, Reporting & Administration Evaluate the performance of PR campaigns and media traction using advanced analytics platforms to generate comprehensive sentiment and ROI reports. Maintain accurate, up-to-date media contact databases, press kits, and archival repositories to streamline future outreach efforts. Promote a positive safety culture across all daily administrative duties, strictly complying with RDMC RQHSE policies and reporting any security or environmental infractions. Safety Responsibilities Promote a positive safety culture within the workplace and attend any safety-related meetings or briefings as required within the job role. Comply with the requirements of RDMC RQHSE Policy and Safety Management System. Be mindful that Safety, Security, and Environmental protection are everyone’s responsibility. All staff members are accountable for reporting and intervening in any Safety, Security, or Environmental violations. Qualifications ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field. Professional fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken); French is an advantage. Knowledge Advanced understanding of media relations workflows, press syndication networks, and modern communication channels. Solid familiarity with transportation, mobility, logistics, or large-scale infrastructure industry dynamics. Proficiency in professional PR, media monitoring, and sentiment analysis tools. Experience 5–7 years of progressive professional experience in public relations, corporate communications, or journalism, preferably within transportation, infrastructure, or heavy industry sectors. DESIRED BEHAVIORS Proactive & Resilient: Maintains a calm, authoritative presence during high-pressure operational incidents and tight-deadline crises. Detail-Oriented: Possesses a meticulous eye for editorial precision, ensuring absolute accuracy and discretion in all public releases. Collaborative Communicator: Excels at bridging technical operational data with engaging, human-centric public narratives. Forward-Thinking: Stays ahead of digital communication trends, AI-driven sentiment tracking, and modern stakeholder engagement strategies.
